title: Gram matrix of a linear map: symmetric, positive semidefinite, with trace |D|^2
statement: For all natural numbers n, l and every continuous linear map D : R^n -> R^l (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), let e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 (a in Fin n) be the standard basis of R^n and let G be the real n x n matrix G_ab := <D e_a, D e_b> (Matrix.of fun a b => inner ℝ (D e_a) (D e_b)). Then (i) G is symmetric, G^T = G (Matrix.IsSymm G); (ii) for every x : Fin n -> R the quadratic form x . (G x) = sum_a x_a sum_b G_ab x_b (dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec G x)) is >= 0; (iii) trace G = sum_a G_aa equals hsNormSq D = sum_a |D e_a|^2.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), Matrix.IsSymm (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) ∧ (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ dotProduct x (Matrix.mulVec (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) x)) ∧ Matrix.trace (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (D (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (D (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ)))) = hsNormSq D
